adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a persistent `cook_method` on `Post` (`Post.cook_methods`, migration adding `posts.cook_method`, and `Post#cook` early-returning `raw` when `raw_html`). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and later updates via `PostRevisor#revise!` do not reset or constrain `cook_method`, so subsequent edits continue to bypass the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline (`Post#cook` returns `raw`). The embed view also renders `raw post.cooked`, so if an editor can set arbitrary HTML in `raw`, it will be emitted unsanitized, enabling XSS on the forum origin.
